author: Komorebi P.
claim_boundary: This is an independent read-only NumPy sensitivity probe of the twelve already sealed v0.4 checkpoints. It does not alter any v0.4 gate and cannot establish a universal quotient or architecture-independent Neuralese.

source_panel.checkpoint_reader: restricted inert tensor-descriptor unpickler; PyTorch is not imported

sealed_bank.name: null
sealed_bank.context_policy: regenerate the exact zero-length D4 bank and require every stored tensor receipt to match before checkpoint loading

stress_prefixes.semantic_requirement: each expanded prefix must be the identity on all eight visible states in every sealed context

continuations.policy: retain every syntactically distinct binary word in length-then-lexicographic order; do not collapse D4-equivalent presentations

prototype.fit_contexts: opposite parity from the evaluation context
prototype.fit_prefixes: the two stress-prefix families other than the evaluated family
prototype.estimator: normalized oriented Euclidean mean with float64 accumulation, cast to float32 before continuation

wrong_control.definition: convert the factual visible state through inverse phi, apply the canonical D4 rotation map r within its four-state coset, and map back through phi

selector_contract.tie_break: lowest visible state index, matching NumPy and PyTorch argmax
selector_contract.nearest_score: oriented Euclidean cosine computed in float64 from finite float32 endpoints; any norm at most 1e-12 is undefined and fails the checkpoint before intervention
selector_contract.self_decoder_validity: every decoder-logit row used for a selector must be finite or the checkpoint fails before intervention
audits: section consistency on every learned anchor
selector idempotence after resetting to the selected anchor
one-step semantic commutation for both generators in every sealed context

numerics.learned_path: NumPy float32 reconstruction of table encoding, polar factor, anchors, recurrence normalization, interventions, continuation, and decoder, with source formula and operation order followed where feasible
numerics.diagnostics: float64 after float32 endpoint and logit construction
numerics.backend_note: This is a NumPy reconstruction sensitivity, not a bitwise or 1e-6 equivalence claim for packaged PyTorch. NumPy BLAS, reduction, and SVD kernels may round differently even when dtype, formulas, and operation order match; the discrepancy can accumulate through a long rollout.
numerics.polar_note: NumPy SVD is an independent float32 implementation and may choose a different valid polar factor near rank deficiency. Report raw-operator singular-value diagnostics for every checkpoint.
numerics.softmax_and_total_variation: promote float32 logits to float64, compute softmax, then TV = 0.5 * sum(abs(p - q))
numerics.endpoint_validity: task correctness and prediction agreement require an all-finite logit row and an all-finite hidden ray with float64 norm strictly above 1e-12; zero or undefined rays are counted and never receive argmax credit
numerics.undefined_h4_angle_policy: for both clean and native references, count explicitly and substitute pi in every suffix maximum
numerics.undefined_h4_total_variation_policy: for both clean and native references, count explicitly and substitute one in every suffix maximum

bank_spending: The sealed null bank was exposed by the preceding v0.4 cross-check, so every result here is a labeled sensitivity. Once this script exposes new learned outcomes, any revision and rerun on the same bank remains posthoc sensitivity and cannot earn a prospective gate.
reported_comparisons: decision agreement with the clean semantic-anchor endpoint
decision agreement with the native path endpoint
joint correctness, damage, and rescue counts against both clean and native references
softmax total variation from both clean and native endpoints, plus per-context/state all-suffix maxima
oriented centered-logit angle from both clean and native endpoints, plus per-context/state all-suffix maxima
oriented hidden angle from both clean and native endpoints, plus per-context/state all-suffix maxima
maximum length-at-most-four discrepancy per context and start
wrong-anchor counterfactual accuracy and factual leakage

unlock_requirements: change status to FROZEN_POSTHOC_NULL_SENSITIVITY only after review
write the exact SHA-256 of the final PROTOCOL.json bytes to FROZEN_PROTOCOL.sha256

implementation_receipts.binding: The final protocol binds both the executable learned path and its independent tests; any code edit requires review, new digests here, and a new protocol receipt before another learned run.
